api.setMood: idle|attack|hurt|phase|rewind|death. death holds its last pose
api.setPhase: rig.setPhase(1|2|3) sets the settled look (Tick, Tock, Midnight) with no animation; ?phase=1|2|3 does the same
api.phaseTo: rig.setPhaseTo(2|3) before setMood('phase'): the one phase mood plays Tick to Tock (2) or Tock to Midnight (3); default is the next phase. ?phaseTo= works too
api.setBroken: rig.setBroken({'clock-bell': true}); ?broken=id,id (short ids ok: bell, hour, drill) or all
api.seq: rig.seq('phase2') and rig.seq('phase3') are recorder aliases for the phase mood with phaseTo 2 and 3

stage: stage aspect 1356 x 1492 (painting plus pad); anchors are image pixels
